{
  "sql": "SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_course_id
JOIN Courses c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN Sections ssec ON c.course_id = ssec.course_id
JOIN Semesters ssem ON ssec.semester_id = ssem.semester_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
ORDER BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name
LIMIT 1;"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, s.student_id
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_course_id
JOIN Courses c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN Sections ssec ON c.course_id = ssec.course_id
JOIN Degree_Programs d ON ssec.student_enrolment_id = d.degree_program_id
JOIN Departments dpt ON d.department_id = dpt.department_id
WHERE d.degree_program_id IN (SELECT degree_program_id FROM Degree_Programs WHERE degree_summary_name = '2 degree programs')
ORDER BY s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT first_name, middle_name, last_name, student_id, degree_program_id, semester_id
FROM Students
JOIN Degree_Programs ON Students.student_id = Degree_Programs.degree_program_id
JOIN Semesters ON Degree_Programs.semester_id = Semesters.semester_id
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses ON Student_Enrolment_Courses.course_id = Courses.course_id
JOIN Courses ON Courses.course_id = Student_Enrolment_Courses.course_id
JOIN Sections ON Sections.course_id = Courses.course_id
JOIN Students ON Students.student_id = Student_Enrolment.student_id
JOIN Semester_Enrolments ON Semester_Enrolments.semester_id = Semesters.semester_id
JOIN Degree_Programs ON Degree_Programs.degree_program_id = Semester_Enrolments.degree_program_id
WHERE Semester_Enrolments.semester_name = 'One Semester' AND Semester_Enrolments.semester_description = 'One Semester' AND Semester_Enrolments.semester_id = Semester_Enrolments.semester_id;"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT D.degree_program_id, S.first_name, D.degree_summary_name
